articles.title: Govt may be going slow on FCRA to woo DMK, NCP(SP) for delimitation
articles.summary: As Parliament approaches its closing week, the FCRA amendment bill is notably absent from Monday's Lok Sabha agenda, signaling a possible political strategy from the government. The legislation's contentious nature is drawing connections to the pending delimitation exercise.

articles.title: Jharkhand students to gherao state assembly today as talks fail
articles.summary: Job aspirants in Ranchi are resolute in staging an assembly gherao, disregarding governmental entreaties and discussions. The impasse continues, driven by demands for a CBI investigation and the annulment of the JSSC-CGL 2024 exam.

articles.title: LeT operative linked to 26/11 Mumbai attacks dies in Pak; poisoning suspected
articles.summary: In a puzzling incident, a prominent Lashkar-e-Taiba member, Qari Saeed Abdul Aziz, was found dead in Islamabad on August 8. Known for his role in orchestrating the 26/11 Mumbai attacks, Aziz collapsed near a mosque after a meal at an unfamiliar restaurant.
